snippet.title: GUNS AND NUNS Storming Hell - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Demons are not the danger, YOU ARE THE DANGER!!! Get another look at Guns and Nuns: Storming Hell in this latest trailer for the upcoming FPS game. In Guns and Nuns: Storming Hell, play as Angelica Amadeus, a nun with the power of faith and guns. Slay demons at your heart's content on bizarre stages with strange gravity fields. Get highscores to unlock more stages and weapons and teach those filthy demons their place. Guns and Nuns: Storming Hell will be available on PC on April 6 of 2026.
